model_output.verdict: A current supervisor with web development and billing experience, but no clear target or measure of the latest work.
write_up: It’s common for a resume to show several kinds of work without naming a target. Yours moves from medical billing to freelance web development and shift supervision. Without a job target or more detail about the current role, a recruiter has to guess which experience matters most, and the resume may not stand out in a pile.

The medical billing line about entering claims for a 4-physician practice works well because it names both the task and the practice. The freelance role has no dates, so a recruiter can’t tell when that work took place.

Let’s start with the Saguaro Market role: add the number of people you supervise and your part in ordering and resets. Then date the freelance work and choose a target that brings the most relevant experience forward.
